entries.en: Hey, is there something I can do for you? 'Cause I'm kinda busy.
entries.ro: Hei, cu ce te pot ajuta? Că sunt cam ocupat.

entries.en: Look, uh, I-I got a meeting.
Uh-huh… Yeah… But they didn't fire me, did they…? Ouch…
entries.ro: Aham… Da… Dar nu m-au dat afară, nu?… Au…

entries.en: Yes… I was at work all night, closing a deal with Tokyo.
entries.ro: Da… Am stat la birou toată noaptea, făceam o înțelegere cu Tokyo.

entries.en: I got a wife and kids!
I don't need this shit today, friend.
entries.ro: Nu am nevoie de rahatul ăsta azi, prietene.

entries.en: Fuck 'em, more for us, man…! It's our time now…!
entries.ro: Să-i ia dracu', mai mult pentru noi, mă…! E vremea noastră acum…!
